name: higgsfield
description: Higgsfield is a generative media platform that provides an API, CLI, and MCP server for creating AI images, video, audio, voices, 3D assets, and marketing/social content across 30+ underlying models (Soul, Cinema Studio, Flux, Seedream, Kling, Veo, etc.).
auth_methods: API key (Key ID:Secret via Authorization header)
gating_notes: Signup and API key generation are instant/self-serve via the Higgsfield Console (console.higgsfield.ai) with no manual approval step. However, actual usage is gated by a credit-based billing system layered on top: the API runs on separate per-call billing from MCP/CLI/Canvas credit consumption, and no free API trial is documented (the main app periodically runs a $0/24h promo, but this is not confirmed for API/CLI/MCP use). Higher rate limits and enterprise invoicing require contacting support.
mcp_notes: Official first-party MCP server at https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp (documented at higgsfield.ai/mcp), exposing image/video/audio/3D generation, character (Soul) training, marketing studio, TikTok publishing, website builder, and more (confirmed by the extensive live Higgsfield MCP tool set available in this session). Separately, Higgsfield ships an official CLI (`@higgsfield/cli`, github.com/higgsfield-ai/cli) plus a companion 'skills' package (github.com/higgsfield-ai/skills) intended for coding agents, distinct from the chat-agent-focused MCP server.
